title: My uber gift card isn't working
description: Download Lyft and get your first ride free up to $10  Use Promo Code: EVANS7221

Blah blah blah, if you have any additional questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out. visual.observation: A screenshot states, "YOU NEED THE MONEY IN YOUR ACCOUNT IN ORDER TO USE THE GIFT CARD BALANCE," while showing temporary hold entries and a negative USD amount; another screen describes the gift card as the sole payment method for a trip.
visual.context: The frames appear to show a payment-support discussion or explanation about using an Uber gift card, but the broader purpose is unclear.
visual.potential_relevance: The visible requirement for separate account funds, linked to using an existing gift-card balance and temporary payment holds, is an unusual payment condition that may merit review.
visual.limitations: These sampled frames do not establish whether the requirement was legitimate, temporary, accurately represented, or associated with any loss, fraud, or deceptive intent.

visual_context_notes.observation: A visible support message says riders should be able to use an Uber gift card as a sole payment method, identifies an issue with that option, and says engineers are working on a fix.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it is framed as a complaint and warning about an Uber gift card not working, including the speaker's purchase, error message, support contacts, and difficulty using the balance. The money flow concerns an existing gift card, ride charges, and temporary holds in a payment-support dispute, not a request for viewers to send money, provide credentials, or join a financial scheme. The Lyft promo code is described as a separate ordinary ride-service promotion unrelated to the Uber gift-card problem.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary content is a warning and examination of a reported payment problem involving an Uber gift card, rather than promotion of a scam mechanism.
